title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements
  • Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll
  • Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions
  • Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs
  • Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do
  • Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format
  • Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing
  • Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours
  • Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

  • Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results)
  • Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in
  • Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native
  • Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught
  • Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography
  • Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought
  • A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly
  • Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
  • Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

  • Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space
  • Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

  • A film degree
  • A fancy reel of cinematic work
  • Experience at a big agency
  • Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

  • Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before.
  • If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.
  • We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference?
  • Did the first frame stop the scroll?
  • Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO?
  • Did you deliver on time?
  • If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.


To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

title: Project Manager #1008790
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager #1008790 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?



Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Estamos em busca de um profissional em projetos de TI que deverá impulsionar a excelência na execução dos projetos, manter o controle sobre escopo, cronograma e orçamento, além de assegurar entregas de alta qualidade em todas as frentes. Esta função será responsável por supervisionar a entrega ponta a ponta de quatro novos mód ulos voltados ao suporte das capacidades de Compras (Procurement), garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio, equipes de TI e uma organização terceirizada de desenvolvimento. O candidato selecionado fará parte de um projeto global em uma empresa multinacional do setor de eletrodomést icos.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:


Gestão do Programa e Supervisão das Entregas (Program & Delivery Oversight)

  • Será responsável pela entrega geral do roadmap dos módulos do Supplier Portal (4 subprojetos), gerenciando cronograma, orçamento, escopo e acompanhamento de marcos (milestones) em nível de programa.
  • Também deverá manter controle rigoroso sobre a definição de escopo, gestão de mudanças e dependências entre projetos e sistemas, além de supervisionar o desempenho do Delivery Manager e da equipe terceirizada para garantir o cumprimento dos compromissos.


Governança e Comitês Executivos (Governance & Steering)

  • Será responsável por definir e conduzir a estrutura de governança do projeto, liderando reuniões de Comitê Executivo (SteerCo), incluindo reporte de status, gestão de riscos e escalonamentos, além dos fóruns de tomada de decisão. Também deverá fornecer visibilidade e relatórios em nível executivo, assegurando transparência sobre o andamento do programa.


Gestão de Stakeholders e Alinhamento com o Negócio (Stakeholder & Business Alignment)

  • Será responsável pelo relacionamento com stakeholders da área de Compras (Procurement) e com a liderança sênior, garantindo que os requisitos de negócio sejam claramente definidos, aprovados e priorizados.
  • Deverá promover o alinhamento entre a área de Negócios (Procurement), as equipes de TI (MDR, PLM e Integração) e a organização responsável pela entrega, atuando ainda como ponto final de escalonamento para conflitos ou ambiguidades relacionadas ao negócio.


Gestão de Riscos e Problemas (Risk & Issue Management)

  • Deverá identificar proativamente riscos e dependências em nível de programa, garantindo que sejam mitigados de forma antecipada e sistemática. Também será responsável por escalar questões críticas com recomendações claras e análise de impacto.


Controle Financeiro e Planejamento (Financial & Planning Control)

  • Será responsável pelo acompanhamento e previsão orçamentária, garantindo que as entregas permaneçam dentro dos limites financeiros aprovados. Também deverá validar a alocação de recursos em conjunto com o Delivery Manager.


Liderança e Direcionamento (Leadership & Direction)

  • Deverá fornecer direcionamento claro e definição de prioridades ao Delivery Manager, garantindo foco em resultados, cumprimento de prazos e geração de valor para o negócio. Espera-se uma atuação proativa na resolução de ambiguidades e na remoção de impedimentos para acelerar a tomada de decisões e o progresso do programa.


O que você precisa ter:


  • Inglê s - Avançado (necessário para
  • Experiência como Gerente de Projetos de TI em ambientes complexos e com múltiplas frentes de trabalho simultâneas.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis de entrega (Agile).
  • Capacidade de gerenciar equipes de desenvolvimento terceirizadas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação.
  • Forte capacidade de organização e definição de prioridades.
  • Habilidade para atuar como ponte entre as necessidades do negócio e a entrega técnica.
  • Perfil altamente proativo e orientado à solução de problemas.
  • Elevada atenção aos detalhes, mantendo ao mesmo tempo uma visão estratégica e abrangente do projeto.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos de forma antecipada, reduzindo impactos ao programa.
  • Entregar soluções escaláveis e de alta qualidade, alinhadas à estratégia da plataforma Supplier Portal.


Modelo de atuação: No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office!

title: Solutions Engineer — Warehouse Automation & Robotics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Engineer — Warehouse Automation & Robotics em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Shape the future of warehouse automation with a global leader in AMR robotics.

Our client is a global leader in Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) solutions is transforming how warehouses pick, move, and sort at scale. With rapid growth across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, our client is looking for a Solutions Engineer to help turn complex logistics challenges into intelligent, robot-driven solutions.

If you love translating operational problems into elegant automation designs, this is your role.


What you'll do

You'll be the technical bridge between clients and the robotics — designing tailored automation solutions and seeing them through to deployment.

  • Design & consult: Engage clients to understand their operations and goals, then architect customized AMR solutions that optimize warehouse workflows.
  • Own the technical story: Serve as the subject-matter expert on the company's products. Produce solution architecture, system specs, and layouts that engineering and implementation teams can execute.
  • Collaborate to deploy: Partner with WMS/WES software engineers to define requirements and ensure seamless, on-time deployments. Coordinate with contractors where robotics meet broader logistics operations.
  • Win and grow accounts: Build and deliver compelling proposals around operational benefits, ROI, and deployment roadmaps aligned with each client's growth strategy.


What you bring

  • Bachelor's in Supply Chain Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years in warehousing automation, logistics, or supply chain operations.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD 2D layout design (required).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Comfort working both independently and within a collaborative team.
  • Willingness to travel to client and project sites as needed.


Nice to have

  • Project management experience.
  • WMS/WES/WCS integration experience.
  • Full English Proficiency

title: Remote Physics Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Expert em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

  • Design and solve challenging Physics problems to evaluate and identify the limitations of large language models.
  • Develop clear, high-quality, step-by-step solutions with precise and well-articulated reasoning.
  • Collaborate closely with LLM researchers to align problem design with evaluation objectives, particularly in areas where models typically struggle, such as abstraction, multi-step reasoning, and symbolic manipulation.
  • Contribute to the development of new evaluation benchmarks based on Physics curricula ranging from early undergraduate concepts to advanced PhD-level topics.
  • Analyze model outputs, identify reasoning gaps, and provide insights to improve model accuracy and performance.
  • Support the advancement of AI research by combining domain expertise in Physics with analytical and problem-solving methodologies.


Requirements :

  • Analytical Skills: Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capability to evaluate complex information and identify meaningful insights.
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback, detailed annotations, and clear evaluations to support continuous improvement.
  • Creative Thinking: Strong creative and lateral thinking skills, with the ability to approach problems from multiple perspectives and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote and cross-functional environment.
  • Independence: Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while managing tasks and deadlines efficiently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Access to a reliable desktop or laptop and a stable high-speed internet connection to support remote collaboration and project work.


Preferred Qualification:

  • Candidates who have completed a Master’s, Ph.D., or Postdoctoral degree in Physics, Applied Physics, or a closely related field are eligible and strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Strong ability to analyze and solve complex Physics problems using a structured, logical, and methodical approach.
  • Ability to explain Physics concepts clearly and effectively through simplified explanations, visual representations, and strong conceptual reasoning.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?



Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Estamos em busca de um profissional em projetos de TI que deverá impulsionar a excelência na execução dos projetos, manter o controle sobre escopo, cronograma e orçamento, além de assegurar entregas de alta qualidade em todas as frentes. O candidato selecionado fará parte de um projeto global em uma empresa multinacional do setor de eletrodomést icos.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:


Gestão do Programa e Supervisão das Entregas (Program & Delivery Oversight)

  • Será responsável pela entrega geral do roadmap dos módulos do Supplier Portal (4 subprojetos), gerenciando cronograma, orçamento, escopo e acompanhamento de marcos (milestones) em nível de programa.
  • Também deverá manter controle rigoroso sobre a definição de escopo, gestão de mudanças e dependências entre projetos e sistemas, além de supervisionar o desempenho do Delivery Manager e da equipe terceirizada para garantir o cumprimento dos compromissos.


Governança e Comitês Executivos (Governance & Steering)

  • Será responsável por definir e conduzir a estrutura de governança do projeto, liderando reuniões de Comitê Executivo (SteerCo), incluindo reporte de status, gestão de riscos e escalonamentos, além dos fóruns de tomada de decisão. Também deverá fornecer visibilidade e relatórios em nível executivo, assegurando transparência sobre o andamento do programa.


Gestão de Stakeholders e Alinhamento com o Negócio (Stakeholder & Business Alignment)

  • Será responsável pelo relacionamento com stakeholders da área de Compras (Procurement) e com a liderança sênior, garantindo que os requisitos de negócio sejam claramente definidos, aprovados e priorizados.

  • Será responsável pelo acompanhamento e previsão orçamentária, garantindo que as entregas permaneçam dentro dos limites financeiros aprovados. Também deverá validar a alocação de recursos em conjunto com o Delivery Manager.

  • Deverá fornecer direcionamento claro e definição de prioridades ao Delivery Manager, garantindo foco em resultados, cumprimento de prazos e geração de valor para o negócio. Espera-se uma atuação proativa na resolução de ambiguidades e na remoção de impedimentos para acelerar a tomada de decisões e o progresso do programa.

title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
description:

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.

This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Turing works with most of the leading LLM companies in the world today and your work will enable today’s leading LLMs to attain advanced mathematics proficiency.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement advanced mathematical models and computational techniques to address complex problems across diverse mathematical domains.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights.
  • Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies.
  • Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies.
  • Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.


Desired Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics.
  • Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work.
  • Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.


More details on required skills:

Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage:

Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic

  • Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships.

Algebra and Number Theory

  • Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications.

Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory

  • Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions.

Topology and Geometry

  • Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.

Analysis

  • Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.

Probability and Statistics

  • Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.

Applied Mathematics

  • Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.

title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements
  • Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll
  • Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions
  • Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs
  • Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do
  • Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format
  • Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing
  • Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours
  • Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

  • Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results)
  • Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in
  • Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native
  • Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught
  • Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography
  • Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought
  • A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly
  • Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
  • Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

  • Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space
  • Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

  • A film degree
  • A fancy reel of cinematic work
  • Experience at a big agency
  • Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

  • Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before.
  • If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.
  • We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference?
  • Did the first frame stop the scroll?
  • Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO?
  • Did you deliver on time?
  • If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.


To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

title: Project Manager #1008790
description:

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?



Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Estamos em busca de um profissional em projetos de TI que deverá impulsionar a excelência na execução dos projetos, manter o controle sobre escopo, cronograma e orçamento, além de assegurar entregas de alta qualidade em todas as frentes. Esta função será responsável por supervisionar a entrega ponta a ponta de quatro novos mód ulos voltados ao suporte das capacidades de Compras (Procurement), garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio, equipes de TI e uma organização terceirizada de desenvolvimento. O candidato selecionado fará parte de um projeto global em uma empresa multinacional do setor de eletrodomést icos.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:


Gestão do Programa e Supervisão das Entregas (Program & Delivery Oversight)

  • Será responsável pela entrega geral do roadmap dos módulos do Supplier Portal (4 subprojetos), gerenciando cronograma, orçamento, escopo e acompanhamento de marcos (milestones) em nível de programa.
  • Também deverá manter controle rigoroso sobre a definição de escopo, gestão de mudanças e dependências entre projetos e sistemas, além de supervisionar o desempenho do Delivery Manager e da equipe terceirizada para garantir o cumprimento dos compromissos.


Governança e Comitês Executivos (Governance & Steering)

  • Será responsável por definir e conduzir a estrutura de governança do projeto, liderando reuniões de Comitê Executivo (SteerCo), incluindo reporte de status, gestão de riscos e escalonamentos, além dos fóruns de tomada de decisão. Também deverá fornecer visibilidade e relatórios em nível executivo, assegurando transparência sobre o andamento do programa.


Gestão de Stakeholders e Alinhamento com o Negócio (Stakeholder & Business Alignment)

  • Será responsável pelo relacionamento com stakeholders da área de Compras (Procurement) e com a liderança sênior, garantindo que os requisitos de negócio sejam claramente definidos, aprovados e priorizados.
  • Deverá promover o alinhamento entre a área de Negócios (Procurement), as equipes de TI (MDR, PLM e Integração) e a organização responsável pela entrega, atuando ainda como ponto final de escalonamento para conflitos ou ambiguidades relacionadas ao negócio.


Gestão de Riscos e Problemas (Risk & Issue Management)

  • Deverá identificar proativamente riscos e dependências em nível de programa, garantindo que sejam mitigados de forma antecipada e sistemática. Também será responsável por escalar questões críticas com recomendações claras e análise de impacto.


Controle Financeiro e Planejamento (Financial & Planning Control)

  • Será responsável pelo acompanhamento e previsão orçamentária, garantindo que as entregas permaneçam dentro dos limites financeiros aprovados. Também deverá validar a alocação de recursos em conjunto com o Delivery Manager.


Liderança e Direcionamento (Leadership & Direction)

  • Deverá fornecer direcionamento claro e definição de prioridades ao Delivery Manager, garantindo foco em resultados, cumprimento de prazos e geração de valor para o negócio. Espera-se uma atuação proativa na resolução de ambiguidades e na remoção de impedimentos para acelerar a tomada de decisões e o progresso do programa.


O que você precisa ter:


  • Inglê s - Avançado (necessário para
  • Experiência como Gerente de Projetos de TI em ambientes complexos e com múltiplas frentes de trabalho simultâneas.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis de entrega (Agile).
  • Capacidade de gerenciar equipes de desenvolvimento terceirizadas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação.
  • Forte capacidade de organização e definição de prioridades.
  • Habilidade para atuar como ponte entre as necessidades do negócio e a entrega técnica.
  • Perfil altamente proativo e orientado à solução de problemas.
  • Elevada atenção aos detalhes, mantendo ao mesmo tempo uma visão estratégica e abrangente do projeto.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos de forma antecipada, reduzindo impactos ao programa.
  • Entregar soluções escaláveis e de alta qualidade, alinhadas à estratégia da plataforma Supplier Portal.


Modelo de atuação: No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office!

title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements
  • Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll
  • Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions
  • Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs
  • Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do
  • Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format
  • Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing
  • Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours
  • Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

  • Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results)
  • Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in
  • Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native
  • Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught
  • Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography
  • Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought
  • A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly
  • Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
  • Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

  • Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space
  • Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

  • A film degree
  • A fancy reel of cinematic work
  • Experience at a big agency
  • Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

  • Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before.
  • If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.
  • We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference?
  • Did the first frame stop the scroll?
  • Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO?
  • Did you deliver on time?
  • If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.


To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

title: Remote Biology Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Biology Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Biological Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and enhance the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing biology-centered discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental and observational data, identify biological patterns, infer underlying mechanisms, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes in living systems. The ideal candidate combines expertise in biological sciences, data interpretation, and scientific methodology to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like:

Designed biology-based reasoning scenarios using experimental datasets, observational studies, and simulated biological systems.Authored multi-step tasks involving pattern recognition, hypothesis generation, parameter estimation, and predictive biological reasoning. Developed evaluation problems focused on genetics, cellular processes, ecological systems, population dynamics, and biological consistency checks. Created deterministic solutions, reference explanations, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment. Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualificati ons:

Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in biology, life sciences research, bioinformatics, scientific analysis, or related analytical disciplines. Applied strong knowledge of biological systems, scientific reasoning, quantitative analysis, and experimental methodologies. Utilized expertise in genetics, molecular biology, ecology, physiology, data interpretation, or simulation-based biological modeling. Communicated complex biological concepts, assumptions, and findings through clear and structured documentation. Evaluated scientific reasoning with exceptional attention to detail, logical consistency, and reproducible outcomes.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 8 weeks.

title: Remote Chemistry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Chemistry Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Chemical Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing chemistry-centered discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated data, identify chemical relationships, infer reaction rules and molecular behaviors, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes under varying conditions. The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in chemistry, quantitative analysis, and scientific methodology to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like

  • Designed chemistry-based reasoning scenarios using experimental results, molecular data, and simulated chemical systems.
  • Authored multi-step tasks involving reaction analysis, chemical property inference, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning.
  • Developed evaluation problems focused on pattern discovery, reaction mechanisms, model selection, and scientific consistency checks.
  • Created deterministic solutions, reference explanations, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in chemistry, chemical research, scientific computing, laboratory analysis, or related analytical fields.
  • Applied strong knowledge of chemical principles, scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, and data interpretation.
  • Utilized expertise in experimental design, reaction mechanisms, stoichiometry, thermodynamics, kinetics, or simulation-based analysis.
  • Communicated complex chemical concepts, assumptions, and findings through clear and structured documentation.
  • Evaluated scientific reasoning with exceptional attention to detail, logical consistency, and reproducible outcomes.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Remote Physics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Scientific Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and enhance the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing data-driven scientific discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated observations, identify patterns, infer governing laws, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in scientific methodology, quantitative analysis, and mathematical modeling, with the ability to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Designed scientific reasoning scenarios using experimental, observational, or simulated datasets.
  • Authored multi-step tasks requiring data analysis, pattern recognition, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning.
  • Developed evaluation problems focused on law discovery, model selection, consistency checking, and hypothesis validation.
  • Created reference solutions, deterministic answers, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in physics domain.
  • Applied strong knowledge of scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, data analysis, and experimental methodologies.
  • Utilized expertise in mathematical modeling, parameter estimation, dimensional analysis, and simulation-based problem solving.
  • Communicated complex scientific concepts, assumptions, and solutions clearly through structured documentation.
  • Evaluated reasoning quality with strong attention to logical consistency, ambiguity control, and reproducible outcomes.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Chemistry Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Chemical Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing chemistry-centered discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated data, identify chemical relationships, infer reaction rules and molecular behaviors, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes under varying conditions. The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in chemistry, quantitative analysis, and scientific methodology to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.

  • Designed chemistry-based reasoning scenarios using experimental results, molecular data, and simulated chemical systems.

  • Developed evaluation problems focused on pattern discovery, reaction mechanisms, model selection, and scientific consistency checks.
  • Created deterministic solutions, reference explanations, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in chemistry, chemical research, scientific computing, laboratory analysis, or related analytical fields.
  • Applied strong knowledge of chemical principles, scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, and data interpretation.
  • Utilized expertise in experimental design, reaction mechanisms, stoichiometry, thermodynamics, kinetics, or simulation-based analysis.
  • Communicated complex chemical concepts, assumptions, and findings through clear and structured documentation.
  • Evaluated scientific reasoning with exceptional attention to detail, logical consistency, and reproducible outcomes.

title: Remote Chemistry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Chemistry Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Chemical Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing chemistry-centered discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated data, identify chemical relationships, infer reaction rules and molecular behaviors, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes under varying conditions. The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in chemistry, quantitative analysis, and scientific methodology to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like

  • Designed chemistry-based reasoning scenarios using experimental results, molecular data, and simulated chemical systems.
  • Authored multi-step tasks involving reaction analysis, chemical property inference, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning.
  • Developed evaluation problems focused on pattern discovery, reaction mechanisms, model selection, and scientific consistency checks.
  • Created deterministic solutions, reference explanations, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in chemistry, chemical research, scientific computing, laboratory analysis, or related analytical fields.
  • Applied strong knowledge of chemical principles, scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, and data interpretation.
  • Utilized expertise in experimental design, reaction mechanisms, stoichiometry, thermodynamics, kinetics, or simulation-based analysis.
  • Communicated complex chemical concepts, assumptions, and findings through clear and structured documentation.
  • Evaluated scientific reasoning with exceptional attention to detail, logical consistency, and reproducible outcomes.

The Accounting Analyst position serves as the key internal contact for the company's financial information, with full visibility of transactions and responsibility for the source data used in decision-making. title: Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Icon makes winning ads and branded content for some of the fastest-growing DTC and enterprise companies in the world. We're now launching our managed creative/ads services and looking to scale our team aggressively. We're on a mission to become a trillion dollar generational company.


Overview

We're hiring an Account Manager to own our client relationships end-to-end. You'll be the face of Icon to the brands we work with — making sure they're getting results, renewing, and expanding, while keeping our creative team pointed at the highest-impact work every single day. You'll be part relationship-builder, part strategist — we'll rely on you to keep clients happy, informed, and growing their spend with us. At the same time, you'll be the connective tissue between the client and our creative pipeline — as an agency producing tens of thousands of ads per month, you'll make sure every client's goals translate cleanly into briefs, deliverables, and performance. You are the person who makes sure clients stay, win, and scale with Icon.


What You'll Own

1) Client Relationships & Retention (Trust + Renewals)

Own the day-to-day relationship: you're the primary point of contact and the person clients trust.

Run regular check-ins, updates, and reviews so clients always know where things stand. Set clear expectations and manage them proactively (no surprises, no silence).

Catch dissatisfaction and churn risk early — and drive the save before it's a cancellation.

Hit renewal and retention targets across your book of business.


2) Account Growth (Expansion + Spend)

Identify upsell and expansion opportunities (more creators, more ad volume, new product lines). Build the case for growth with performance data and clear ROI.

Coordinate with sales/leadership to close expansions and renewals.

Grow each account's spend over time by proving Icon's value continuously.

Turn happy clients into references, case studies, and referrals.


3) Execution & Cross-functional Coordination (Briefs + Performance)

Translate client goals into clear, actionable briefs for the creative team.

Coordinate priorities with Creative Ops so client work ships on time and at quality.

Track and report on creative performance (delivery, throughput, results) back to clients.

Own escalations: when something slips, you drive the fix across teams.

Work closely with Ops and Engineering to remove recurring friction in the client workflow.


You're a Fit If You…

Have experience in account management / client success / agency relationship management (especially high-volume or performance-driven environments).

Can build trust fast and manage clients with both warmth and high standards.

Are commercially sharp: you spot growth opportunities and know how to close them.

Are obsessive about follow-through, communication, and never letting a client feel ignored.

Can translate messy client needs into clear requirements for the creative and eng teams.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments.


You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.).
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa).
  • Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations.
  • Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures.
  • Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency.
  • Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS).
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings.
  • Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil.
  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus.
  • Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Third Interview: A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media
