title: Finance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About MasterPro


MasterPro Installs Corp is a licensed appliance delivery and installation company operating in different States. We are an authorized installer for major national retail partners and operate a mixed field workforce across multiple markets. We move fast, hold ourselves to high performance standards, and are building the financial infrastructure to match our growth.


About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager who has worked inside field service, home services, trades, or contractor-based businesses — someone who understands what job costing actually means, knows how to read a P&L in an operations-heavy company, and isn't intimidated by multi-state complexity. This is a hands-on role where you will own the numbers from end to end.


What You'll Do


Financial Reporting & Controls


  • Own the full monthly close process including journal entries, P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements
  • Prepare and deliver monthly financial reports and variance analysis to the CEO and department leads
  • Maintain the general ledger and ensure accuracy across all accounts
  • Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations
  • Manage day-to-day financial operations across QuickBooks Online, Bill.com, Gusto, and Square Payroll and others

    • KPI Reporting & Performance Analytics


    • Design and own individual KPI dashboards and scorecards for every professional in the company — field and office
    • Build reporting frameworks that translate operational metrics (installs completed, damage claims, survey scores, efficiency rates) into financial performance indicators
    • Produce weekly and monthly KPI reports distributed to team leads and the CEO
    • Partner with operations to align field performance data with job-level cost outcomes
    • Continuously refine reporting as the team scales into new markets


    Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow


    • Lead the annual budgeting process and monthly rolling forecasts
    • Manage and present 13-week cash flow forecasts to support operational decision-making
    • Analyze per-install job costing and track margin by market, job type, and crew
    • Monitor fleet and operational expenses and identify cost-reduction opportunities


    Multi-State Compliance & Tax


    • Coordinate multi-state payroll tax compliance across CA, OR, LA, TX, and WA
    • Support state business license renewals, sales tax obligations, and regulatory filings across all active markets
    • Serve as internal point of contact for external CPAs, auditors, and any fractional CFO support
    • Maintain workers' comp classification accuracy across W-2 and subcontractor workforce structures


    Systems & Process


    • Manage and improve financial systems and workflows including QuickBooks Online, Bill.com, Microsoft Power BI, and Monday.com
    • Implement financial policies and internal controls that scale with the business
    • Train and support office staff on financial procedures and systems


    What We're Looking For


    Experience


    • 5+ years in finance, accounting, or FP&A — with at least 2 years inside a home services, field services, trades, contracting, or installation company in the US
    • Demonstrated experience building KPI reports and individual performance scorecards, not just company-level financials
    • Hands-on background in job costing, per-unit margin analysis, and field workforce financial management
    • Experience managing finances across multiple states including payroll tax and compliance
    • Familiarity with contractor vs. W-2 cost structures and the financial implications of each


    Skills & Tools


    • Expert-level proficiency in QuickBooks Online
    • Experience with Microsoft Power BI or equivalent business intelligence tools (Tableau, Looker, etc.)
    • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets — you build models, not just read them
    • Experience with Bill.com, Gusto, Square Payroll, or equivalent payroll and AP platforms
    • Strong communicator who can translate financial data into plain language for non-finance leaders

    Education

    • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field required
    • CPA or CMA preferred but not required — real-world experience in the trades and services space matters more to us


    What Sets the Right Candidate Apart


    You've sat inside a company where trucks roll every morning and jobs are measured by the install, not the quarter. You know what it takes to hold a distributed field team financially accountable. You've built a report from scratch that a field supervisor could actually use. You don't wait for someone to tell you the numbers are off — you already know before the meeting starts.


    What We Offer


    • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
    • Direct line to and collaboration with the CEO
    • PTO
    • Room to grow into a senior leadership role as the company scales


    To Apply


    Send your resume and a short note (3–5 sentences) about your experience in home services, trades, or installation businesses to  . Applications without industry context will be deprioritized.

title: Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Icon makes winning ads and branded content for some of the fastest-growing DTC and enterprise companies in the world. We're now launching our managed creative/ads services and looking to scale our team aggressively. We're on a mission to become a trillion dollar generational company.


Overview

We're hiring an Account Manager to own our client relationships end-to-end. You'll be the face of Icon to the brands we work with — making sure they're getting results, renewing, and expanding, while keeping our creative team pointed at the highest-impact work every single day. You'll be part relationship-builder, part strategist — we'll rely on you to keep clients happy, informed, and growing their spend with us. At the same time, you'll be the connective tissue between the client and our creative pipeline — as an agency producing tens of thousands of ads per month, you'll make sure every client's goals translate cleanly into briefs, deliverables, and performance. You are the person who makes sure clients stay, win, and scale with Icon.


What You'll Own

1) Client Relationships & Retention (Trust + Renewals)

Own the day-to-day relationship: you're the primary point of contact and the person clients trust.

Run regular check-ins, updates, and reviews so clients always know where things stand. Set clear expectations and manage them proactively (no surprises, no silence).

Catch dissatisfaction and churn risk early — and drive the save before it's a cancellation.

Hit renewal and retention targets across your book of business.


2) Account Growth (Expansion + Spend)

Identify upsell and expansion opportunities (more creators, more ad volume, new product lines). Build the case for growth with performance data and clear ROI.

Coordinate with sales/leadership to close expansions and renewals.

Grow each account's spend over time by proving Icon's value continuously.

Turn happy clients into references, case studies, and referrals.


3) Execution & Cross-functional Coordination (Briefs + Performance)

Translate client goals into clear, actionable briefs for the creative team.

Coordinate priorities with Creative Ops so client work ships on time and at quality.

Track and report on creative performance (delivery, throughput, results) back to clients.

Own escalations: when something slips, you drive the fix across teams.

Work closely with Ops and Engineering to remove recurring friction in the client workflow.


You're a Fit If You…

Have experience in account management / client success / agency relationship management (especially high-volume or performance-driven environments).

Can build trust fast and manage clients with both warmth and high standards.

Are commercially sharp: you spot growth opportunities and know how to close them.

Are obsessive about follow-through, communication, and never letting a client feel ignored.

Can translate messy client needs into clear requirements for the creative and eng teams.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join us at ORION THE LAB to build the future of physical AI and robotics!

We collect and prepare real-world video data used to train physical-AI and robotics models for international clients. We are launching a high-volume egocentric video-capture project in Brazil and Argentina and need a local Operations Manager to build, manage, and scale a local team of contributors on the ground.

If you have a strong local network, experience managing distributed field workers, and thrive on owning quality-driven operations, we want to hear from you.



Role Overview

As the Operations Manager, you are the key executor on the ground. You are entirely responsible for quality and delivery—not just managing a headcount. You will recruit contributors, audit technology compatibility, train teams on capture rules, run QA pre-checks, and handle local payouts


.

What You Will Do

  • Recruit & Scale : Source continuous data contributors who meet device requirements. Scale your team to keep up with growing project demands
  • Onboard & Setup : Install the dedicated project app, create user accounts under verified tracking emails, and correctly configure the organization codes
  • Train for Excellence: Train contributors on strict egocentric filming rules (headset tracking, 45° downward angles, landscape view, 1080p+ resolution, organic and completed home tasks
  • Strict Quality Assurance : Run pre-upload QA checks on all incoming footage. Filter out shaky, tilted, poorly lit, or repetitive videos to maintain a strict 95% client qualification rat
  • Privacy Enforcement: Guard local privacy rules; strictly prohibit filming non-consenting individuals, cooking, or private screens/document
  • Manage Payouts : Distribute payments to your team weekly using per-email qualified data logs and maintain localized accounting records


Compensation & Scale

  • Earning Structure : You are paid $3.00 USD per qualified hour of footage accepted by the client's QA team
  • Team Payout: You pay your local contributors $2.00 USD per qualified hour
  • Your Net Share : Your coordination fee is $1.00 USD per qualified hour

The Opportunity : Starts with a 500-hour test pilot. Upon successful completion, the project scales to an ongoing order of up to 10,000 qualified hours per month ($10,000 USD/month total coordination potential).


Profile Requirements

  • Location : Based in Argentina or Brazil with an expansive, functional network in a major populous city
  • Proven Experience : Direct history recruiting and managing distributed field operations (e.g., census/survey teams, brand promoters, mystery shoppers, or gig/delivery fleets
  • Billing Capacity : Legally able to issue local invoices (factura or cuenta de cobro)
  • Payment Setup : Ready to receive corporate funds and distribute team payments via Mercado Pago, Nequi, Daviplata, or an equivalent digital network
  • Communication : Highly organized and exceptionally fast over WhatsApp. Fluent in Spanish with functional English capabilities.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments.


You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.).
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa).
  • Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations.
  • Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures.
  • Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency.
  • Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS).
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings.
  • Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil.
  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus.
  • Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Third Interview: A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

description:

Job Title: Media Tech Support

Location: Remote (Brazil / Mexico / Costa Rica)

Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Support file-based media workflows and respond to technical support requests.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to transcoding, AutoQC, content delivery, storage, networking, and cloud platforms.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve incidents and perform root cause analysis.
  • Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and escalation procedures.

Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of video, audio, subtitles, and media supply chain workflows.

  • Familiarity with Jira and Slack.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join us at ORION THE LAB to build the future of physical AI and robotics!

We collect and prepare real-world video data used to train physical-AI and robotics models for international clients. We are launching a high-volume egocentric video-capture project in Brazil and Argentina and need a local Operations Manager to build, manage, and scale a local team of contributors on the ground.

If you have a strong local network, experience managing distributed field workers, and thrive on owning quality-driven operations, we want to hear from you.



Role Overview

As the Operations Manager, you are the key executor on the ground. You are entirely responsible for quality and delivery—not just managing a headcount. You will recruit contributors, audit technology compatibility, train teams on capture rules, run QA pre-checks, and handle local payouts


.

What You Will Do

  • Recruit & Scale : Source continuous data contributors who meet device requirements. Scale your team to keep up with growing project demands
  • Onboard & Setup : Install the dedicated project app, create user accounts under verified tracking emails, and correctly configure the organization codes
  • Train for Excellence: Train contributors on strict egocentric filming rules (headset tracking, 45° downward angles, landscape view, 1080p+ resolution, organic and completed home tasks
  • Strict Quality Assurance : Run pre-upload QA checks on all incoming footage. Filter out shaky, tilted, poorly lit, or repetitive videos to maintain a strict 95% client qualification rat
  • Privacy Enforcement: Guard local privacy rules; strictly prohibit filming non-consenting individuals, cooking, or private screens/document
  • Manage Payouts : Distribute payments to your team weekly using per-email qualified data logs and maintain localized accounting records


Compensation & Scale

  • Earning Structure : You are paid $3.00 USD per qualified hour of footage accepted by the client's QA team
  • Team Payout: You pay your local contributors $2.00 USD per qualified hour
  • Your Net Share : Your coordination fee is $1.00 USD per qualified hour

The Opportunity : Starts with a 500-hour test pilot. Upon successful completion, the project scales to an ongoing order of up to 10,000 qualified hours per month ($10,000 USD/month total coordination potential).


Profile Requirements

  • Location : Based in Argentina or Brazil with an expansive, functional network in a major populous city
  • Proven Experience : Direct history recruiting and managing distributed field operations (e.g., census/survey teams, brand promoters, mystery shoppers, or gig/delivery fleets
  • Billing Capacity : Legally able to issue local invoices (factura or cuenta de cobro)
  • Payment Setup : Ready to receive corporate funds and distribute team payments via Mercado Pago, Nequi, Daviplata, or an equivalent digital network
  • Communication : Highly organized and exceptionally fast over WhatsApp. Fluent in Spanish with functional English capabilities.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About MasterPro


MasterPro Installs Corp is a licensed appliance delivery and installation company operating in different States. We are an authorized installer for major national retail partners and operate a mixed field workforce across multiple markets. We move fast, hold ourselves to high performance standards, and are building the financial infrastructure to match our growth.


About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager who has worked inside field service, home services, trades, or contractor-based businesses — someone who understands what job costing actually means, knows how to read a P&L in an operations-heavy company, and isn't intimidated by multi-state complexity. This is a hands-on role where you will own the numbers from end to end.


What You'll Do


Financial Reporting & Controls


  • Own the full monthly close process including journal entries, P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements
  • Prepare and deliver monthly financial reports and variance analysis to the CEO and department leads
  • Maintain the general ledger and ensure accuracy across all accounts
  • Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations
  • Manage day-to-day financial operations across QuickBooks Online, Bill.com, Gusto, and Square Payroll and others

    • KPI Reporting & Performance Analytics


    • Design and own individual KPI dashboards and scorecards for every professional in the company — field and office
    • Build reporting frameworks that translate operational metrics (installs completed, damage claims, survey scores, efficiency rates) into financial performance indicators
    • Produce weekly and monthly KPI reports distributed to team leads and the CEO
    • Partner with operations to align field performance data with job-level cost outcomes
    • Continuously refine reporting as the team scales into new markets


    Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow


    • Lead the annual budgeting process and monthly rolling forecasts
    • Manage and present 13-week cash flow forecasts to support operational decision-making
    • Analyze per-install job costing and track margin by market, job type, and crew
    • Monitor fleet and operational expenses and identify cost-reduction opportunities


    Multi-State Compliance & Tax


    • Coordinate multi-state payroll tax compliance across CA, OR, LA, TX, and WA
    • Support state business license renewals, sales tax obligations, and regulatory filings across all active markets
    • Serve as internal point of contact for external CPAs, auditors, and any fractional CFO support
    • Maintain workers' comp classification accuracy across W-2 and subcontractor workforce structures


    Systems & Process


    • Manage and improve financial systems and workflows including QuickBooks Online, Bill.com, Microsoft Power BI, and Monday.com
    • Implement financial policies and internal controls that scale with the business
    • Train and support office staff on financial procedures and systems


    What We're Looking For


    Experience


    • 5+ years in finance, accounting, or FP&A — with at least 2 years inside a home services, field services, trades, contracting, or installation company in the US
    • Demonstrated experience building KPI reports and individual performance scorecards, not just company-level financials
    • Hands-on background in job costing, per-unit margin analysis, and field workforce financial management
    • Experience managing finances across multiple states including payroll tax and compliance
    • Familiarity with contractor vs. W-2 cost structures and the financial implications of each


    Skills & Tools


    • Expert-level proficiency in QuickBooks Online
    • Experience with Microsoft Power BI or equivalent business intelligence tools (Tableau, Looker, etc.)
    • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets — you build models, not just read them
    • Experience with Bill.com, Gusto, Square Payroll, or equivalent payroll and AP platforms
    • Strong communicator who can translate financial data into plain language for non-finance leaders

    Education

    • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field required

We're hiring an Account Manager to own our client relationships end-to-end. You'll be the face of Icon to the brands we work with — making sure they're getting results, renewing, and expanding, while keeping our creative team pointed at the highest-impact work every single day. You'll be part relationship-builder, part strategist — we'll rely on you to keep clients happy, informed, and growing their spend with us. At the same time, you'll be the connective tissue between the client and our creative pipeline — as an agency producing tens of thousands of ads per month, you'll make sure every client's goals translate cleanly into briefs, deliverables, and performance. You are the person who makes sure clients stay, win, and scale with Icon.


What You'll Own

1) Client Relationships & Retention (Trust + Renewals)

Own the day-to-day relationship: you're the primary point of contact and the person clients trust.

Run regular check-ins, updates, and reviews so clients always know where things stand. Set clear expectations and manage them proactively (no surprises, no silence).

Catch dissatisfaction and churn risk early — and drive the save before it's a cancellation.

Hit renewal and retention targets across your book of business.


2) Account Growth (Expansion + Spend)

Identify upsell and expansion opportunities (more creators, more ad volume, new product lines). Build the case for growth with performance data and clear ROI.

Coordinate with sales/leadership to close expansions and renewals.

Grow each account's spend over time by proving Icon's value continuously.

Turn happy clients into references, case studies, and referrals.


3) Execution & Cross-functional Coordination (Briefs + Performance)

Translate client goals into clear, actionable briefs for the creative team.

Coordinate priorities with Creative Ops so client work ships on time and at quality.

Track and report on creative performance (delivery, throughput, results) back to clients.

Own escalations: when something slips, you drive the fix across teams.

Work closely with Ops and Engineering to remove recurring friction in the client workflow.


You're a Fit If You…

Have experience in account management / client success / agency relationship management (especially high-volume or performance-driven environments).

Can build trust fast and manage clients with both warmth and high standards.

Are commercially sharp: you spot growth opportunities and know how to close them.

Are obsessive about follow-through, communication, and never letting a client feel ignored.

Can translate messy client needs into clear requirements for the creative and eng teams.

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

title: Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Icon makes winning ads and branded content for some of the fastest-growing DTC and enterprise companies in the world. We're now launching our managed creative/ads services and looking to scale our team aggressively. We're on a mission to become a trillion dollar generational company.


Overview

We're hiring an Account Manager to own our client relationships end-to-end. You'll be the face of Icon to the brands we work with — making sure they're getting results, renewing, and expanding, while keeping our creative team pointed at the highest-impact work every single day. You'll be part relationship-builder, part strategist — we'll rely on you to keep clients happy, informed, and growing their spend with us. At the same time, you'll be the connective tissue between the client and our creative pipeline — as an agency producing tens of thousands of ads per month, you'll make sure every client's goals translate cleanly into briefs, deliverables, and performance. You are the person who makes sure clients stay, win, and scale with Icon.


What You'll Own

1) Client Relationships & Retention (Trust + Renewals)

Own the day-to-day relationship: you're the primary point of contact and the person clients trust.

Run regular check-ins, updates, and reviews so clients always know where things stand. Set clear expectations and manage them proactively (no surprises, no silence).

Catch dissatisfaction and churn risk early — and drive the save before it's a cancellation.

Hit renewal and retention targets across your book of business.


2) Account Growth (Expansion + Spend)

Identify upsell and expansion opportunities (more creators, more ad volume, new product lines). Build the case for growth with performance data and clear ROI.

Coordinate with sales/leadership to close expansions and renewals.

Grow each account's spend over time by proving Icon's value continuously.

Turn happy clients into references, case studies, and referrals.


3) Execution & Cross-functional Coordination (Briefs + Performance)

Translate client goals into clear, actionable briefs for the creative team.

Coordinate priorities with Creative Ops so client work ships on time and at quality.

Track and report on creative performance (delivery, throughput, results) back to clients.

Own escalations: when something slips, you drive the fix across teams.

Work closely with Ops and Engineering to remove recurring friction in the client workflow.


You're a Fit If You…

Have experience in account management / client success / agency relationship management (especially high-volume or performance-driven environments).

Can build trust fast and manage clients with both warmth and high standards.

Are commercially sharp: you spot growth opportunities and know how to close them.

Are obsessive about follow-through, communication, and never letting a client feel ignored.

Can translate messy client needs into clear requirements for the creative and eng teams.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About MasterPro


MasterPro Installs Corp is a licensed appliance delivery and installation company operating in different States. We are an authorized installer for major national retail partners and operate a mixed field workforce across multiple markets. We move fast, hold ourselves to high performance standards, and are building the financial infrastructure to match our growth.


About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager who has worked inside field service, home services, trades, or contractor-based businesses — someone who understands what job costing actually means, knows how to read a P&L in an operations-heavy company, and isn't intimidated by multi-state complexity. This is a hands-on role where you will own the numbers from end to end.


What You'll Do


Financial Reporting & Controls


  • Own the full monthly close process including journal entries, P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements
  • Prepare and deliver monthly financial reports and variance analysis to the CEO and department leads
  • Maintain the general ledger and ensure accuracy across all accounts
  • Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations
  • Manage day-to-day financial operations across QuickBooks Online, Bill.com, Gusto, and Square Payroll and others

    • KPI Reporting & Performance Analytics


    • Design and own individual KPI dashboards and scorecards for every professional in the company — field and office
    • Build reporting frameworks that translate operational metrics (installs completed, damage claims, survey scores, efficiency rates) into financial performance indicators
    • Produce weekly and monthly KPI reports distributed to team leads and the CEO
    • Partner with operations to align field performance data with job-level cost outcomes
    • Continuously refine reporting as the team scales into new markets


    Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow


    • Lead the annual budgeting process and monthly rolling forecasts
    • Manage and present 13-week cash flow forecasts to support operational decision-making
    • Analyze per-install job costing and track margin by market, job type, and crew
    • Monitor fleet and operational expenses and identify cost-reduction opportunities


    Multi-State Compliance & Tax


    • Coordinate multi-state payroll tax compliance across CA, OR, LA, TX, and WA
    • Support state business license renewals, sales tax obligations, and regulatory filings across all active markets
    • Serve as internal point of contact for external CPAs, auditors, and any fractional CFO support
    • Maintain workers' comp classification accuracy across W-2 and subcontractor workforce structures


    Systems & Process


    • Manage and improve financial systems and workflows including QuickBooks Online, Bill.com, Microsoft Power BI, and Monday.com
    • Implement financial policies and internal controls that scale with the business
    • Train and support office staff on financial procedures and systems


    What We're Looking For


    Experience


    • 5+ years in finance, accounting, or FP&A — with at least 2 years inside a home services, field services, trades, contracting, or installation company in the US
    • Demonstrated experience building KPI reports and individual performance scorecards, not just company-level financials
    • Hands-on background in job costing, per-unit margin analysis, and field workforce financial management
    • Experience managing finances across multiple states including payroll tax and compliance
    • Familiarity with contractor vs. W-2 cost structures and the financial implications of each


    Skills & Tools


    • Expert-level proficiency in QuickBooks Online
    • Experience with Microsoft Power BI or equivalent business intelligence tools (Tableau, Looker, etc.)
    • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets — you build models, not just read them
    • Experience with Bill.com, Gusto, Square Payroll, or equivalent payroll and AP platforms
    • Strong communicator who can translate financial data into plain language for non-finance leaders

    Education

    • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field required
    • CPA or CMA preferred but not required — real-world experience in the trades and services space matters more to us


    What Sets the Right Candidate Apart


    You've sat inside a company where trucks roll every morning and jobs are measured by the install, not the quarter. You know what it takes to hold a distributed field team financially accountable. You've built a report from scratch that a field supervisor could actually use. You don't wait for someone to tell you the numbers are off — you already know before the meeting starts.


    What We Offer


    • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
    • Direct line to and collaboration with the CEO
    • PTO
    • Room to grow into a senior leadership role as the company scales


    To Apply


    Send your resume and a short note (3–5 sentences) about your experience in home services, trades, or installation businesses to  . Applications without industry context will be deprioritized.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join us at ORION THE LAB to build the future of physical AI and robotics!

We collect and prepare real-world video data used to train physical-AI and robotics models for international clients. We are launching a high-volume egocentric video-capture project in Brazil and Argentina and need a local Operations Manager to build, manage, and scale a local team of contributors on the ground.

If you have a strong local network, experience managing distributed field workers, and thrive on owning quality-driven operations, we want to hear from you.



Role Overview

As the Operations Manager, you are the key executor on the ground. You are entirely responsible for quality and delivery—not just managing a headcount. You will recruit contributors, audit technology compatibility, train teams on capture rules, run QA pre-checks, and handle local payouts


.

What You Will Do

  • Recruit & Scale : Source continuous data contributors who meet device requirements. Scale your team to keep up with growing project demands
  • Onboard & Setup : Install the dedicated project app, create user accounts under verified tracking emails, and correctly configure the organization codes
  • Train for Excellence: Train contributors on strict egocentric filming rules (headset tracking, 45° downward angles, landscape view, 1080p+ resolution, organic and completed home tasks
  • Strict Quality Assurance : Run pre-upload QA checks on all incoming footage. Filter out shaky, tilted, poorly lit, or repetitive videos to maintain a strict 95% client qualification rat
  • Privacy Enforcement: Guard local privacy rules; strictly prohibit filming non-consenting individuals, cooking, or private screens/document
  • Manage Payouts : Distribute payments to your team weekly using per-email qualified data logs and maintain localized accounting records


Compensation & Scale

  • Earning Structure : You are paid $3.00 USD per qualified hour of footage accepted by the client's QA team
  • Team Payout: You pay your local contributors $2.00 USD per qualified hour
  • Your Net Share : Your coordination fee is $1.00 USD per qualified hour

The Opportunity : Starts with a 500-hour test pilot. Upon successful completion, the project scales to an ongoing order of up to 10,000 qualified hours per month ($10,000 USD/month total coordination potential).


Profile Requirements

  • Location : Based in Argentina or Brazil with an expansive, functional network in a major populous city
  • Proven Experience : Direct history recruiting and managing distributed field operations (e.g., census/survey teams, brand promoters, mystery shoppers, or gig/delivery fleets
  • Billing Capacity : Legally able to issue local invoices (factura or cuenta de cobro)
  • Payment Setup : Ready to receive corporate funds and distribute team payments via Mercado Pago, Nequi, Daviplata, or an equivalent digital network
  • Communication : Highly organized and exceptionally fast over WhatsApp. Fluent in Spanish with functional English capabilities.

  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS).
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings.
  • Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Arte Finalista (Pleno/Sênior)-  Banco de talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arte Finalista (Pleno/Sênior)- Banco de talentos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um arte-finalista capaz de trabalhar com rapidez, eficiência e mantendo grande atenção aos detalhes. O profissional deve ser altamente organizado e conseguir trabalhar em mais de um projeto ao mesmo tempo. Entre as atividades, a principal será fazer ajustes e alterações de cor, formato, texto, imagens e preparação dos arquivos para impressão (com sangria, marcas de corte e ficha técnica).

O candidato precisa ter um conhecimento avançado no Adobe InDesign já que 95% do trabalho será feito nele, e o nível de inglês para escrita e interpretação de texto também precisa ser avançado. A atividade diária principal será receber artes prontas das agências dos EUA para executar ajustes (no InDesign) conforme comentários (em inglês) feitos no PDF. Além disso, será necessário também montar facas especiais e fazer o envio dos arquivos para a gráfica.

Num primeiro momento o profissional estará sob supervisão para garantir o entendimento e fluxo de funcionamento do estúdio, mas com o passar do tempo a idéia é ganhar autonomia para realizar as tarefas mais cotidianas e recorrentes sem muita supervisão.


Pré-Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada no segmento impresso e em todos os detalhes que o meio exige (marcas de corte, sangría, margens de segurança, dobras, vinco, cores CMYK, facas especiais, e fichas técnicas);
  • Graduação em Design Gráfico, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência de pelo menos 5+ anos na função como designer gráfico no ramo impresso.
  • Domínio dos software InDesign e illustrator;
  • Inglês avançado (com comprovação via teste ao vivo na segunda etapa do processo);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar das 10h as 19h ou das 13h as 22h.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Ter atuado ativamente com fechamento de arquivos, arte-final e preparação de arquivos para impressão.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de gestão de tarefas como Monday ou Trello (aqui utilizamos WorkFront);



Está preparado(a) para cultivar novas experiências em um time que joga junto e valoriza o melhor de cada um(a)?


#VEMSERSTUDIORX


--

Consideramos todas as aplicações para nossas vagas sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, cultura, origem, religião, deficiência, idade etc. Acreditamos na construção de um mundo mais diverso, com mais representatividade e livre de preconceitos. title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager

Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil


The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.


We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


About The Render Pros / VEXOS


We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


The Role


The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.


You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


✅ What You'll Be Responsible For


• Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM

• Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials

• Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person

• Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date

• Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track

• Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed

• Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


What We're Looking For


Experience

• 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role

• Experience working with SaaS platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus

• Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement


Skills

• Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily

• Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly

• Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure

• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift


Mindset

• You follow through. Every time.

• You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated

• You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients

• You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de francês em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Social Media Lead/Community Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.
