Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance, Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Analista Jr Front Office (Investimentos)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Jr Front Office (Investimentos) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga: Analista de Suporte N1 – Front Office (Capital Markets)

Contexto

Buscamos profissional para atuar no suporte de primeiro nível (N1) às aplicações de Front Office de uma grande instituição financeira, com foco em Mercado de Capitais / Renda Fixa . O profissional será responsável por garantir a estabilidade operacional dos sistemas utilizados pelas mesas de operações, atuando como ponto de contato direto entre traders, Middle Office e times de tecnologia.

Responsabilidades

  • Prestar suporte N1 às aplicações de renda fixa do Front Office.
  • Manter interação constante com traders e Middle Office para tratamento de incidentes e dúvidas operacionais.
  • Executar conciliações diárias (daily reconciliation) das operações e posições.
  • Identificar, analisar e escalar chamados para o suporte de N2 quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar e dar follow-up nos tickets , garantindo a resolução dentro do SLA.
  • Apoiar atividades de validação de dados (data validation) .
  • Participar de testes básicos (funcionais e de homologação dos sistemas).

Requisitos

  • Vivência em ambiente de Front Office (mesa de operações) .
  • Conhecimento do ciclo de vida das operações (trade lifecycle) e da interação entre Front e Middle Office .
  • Fundamentos de Renda Fixa, Títulos e Derivativos .
  • Conceitos de P&L, fluxo de caixa e apreçamento (valuation) .
  • Perfil de suporte N1 com domínio em Capital Markets .
  • Experiência hands-on em sistemas de trading (Bloomberg e/ou Murex) .
  • Sólidas habilidades de conciliação e gestão de stakeholders .
  • Inglês avançado para atender clientes internacionais

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Murex .
  • Habilidades em SQL e scripting (automação de rotinas).
  • Exposição a múltiplas classes de ativos (multi-asset) .
  • Visão de ITSM e mentalidade voltada à automação de processos .

Vivência com relés SEL, Siemens, ABB, Schneider, GE;

Experiência com SCADA, telecom e integração de sistemas.

title: Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications


Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs: Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding. - Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada. -Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes. - Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência.
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros)
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);
  • Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA;
  • Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless;
  • Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;
  • Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility);
  • Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA;
  • Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações;
  • Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
  • Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);
  • Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform);
  • Certificação AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate);




Modelo de atuação: Home Office, mas precisa ter disponibilidade para viajar esporadicamente;

Contratação CLT


O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;



Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Financial Advisor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Financial Advisor em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A IBBRA Full Family Office é uma consultoria patrimonial 360º. Nosso propósito é ser para as famílias Brasileiras, um agente de mudança cultural em torno do patrimônio, fomentando emancipação e a realização de objetivos


Buscamos para nossa equipe pessoas dispostas a mudar a cultura patrimonial das famílias brasileiras enquanto se desenvolvem, estruram-se e alcançam novos horizontes.


O executivo de vendas irá atuar no desenvolvimento e gestão da carteira de clientes de alto patrimônio, conduzindo o relacionamento comercial, identificando oportunidades de negócio e assegurando uma experiência consultiva e integrada ao longo de toda a jornada comercial do cliente.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com o cliente, sendo o principal contato e conselheiro de confiança, prestando consultoria em disponibilidade total e permanente à família atendida.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, estratégica e contínua na jornada patrimonial
  • Atrair, desenvolver e gerir carteira de clientes de alta renda, com foco em crescimento e retenção
  • Implementar e monitorar estratégias de planejamento patrimonial abrangentes (investimentos, sucessão, proteção e gestão orçamentária), assegurando aderência aos objetivos familiares
  • Supervisionar carteiras de investimentos e a evolução patrimonial, propondo ajustes conforme perfil de risco e cenário econômico
  • Conduzir análises financeiras aprofundadas para otimização e alavancagem patrimonial
  • Coordenar ações multidisciplinares com advogados, contadores e outros especialistas
  • Coletar e analisar dados financeiros e contextuais, gerando inteligência para tomada de decisão
  • Promover educação financeira e apoiar a autonomia dos clientes e suas famílias
  • Atuar com postura ética, fiduciária e independente, em conformidade com as regulamentações


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Economia, Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente e/ou mercado financeiro
  • Habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento
  • Certificação CPA (mínimo) ou em andamento
  • Diferencial: Certificações CFP®, CEA, Ancord, PQO
  • Diferencial: Inglês intermediário ou avançado


O que oferecemos?

  • Ambiente colaborativo, com oportunidade real de crescimento profissional;
  • Treinamentos e acompanhamento para desenvolvimento das suas habilidades;
  • Incentivo intelectual.


Informações da vaga:

  • Plano de carreira e comissionamento compatível com o mercado

  • Local (para residentes em Goiânia - Goiás): Rua 1135, 318 - Marista, Goiânia - GO,

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.

This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership.


Key Responsibilities:


Advanced English


• Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers.


• Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks.


• Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements.

Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)


• Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT.


• Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks.


• Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups.


SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:


o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based)


o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views


o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains


Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:


o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures

o CDS Views (where applicable)

• Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.


• Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy.


Reporting & Analytics:


Oversee reporting solutions using:


o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)


• Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain).


Migration & Modernization:


Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including:


o Readiness checks and simplification item handling


o Remediation of custom code and data models


o Data volume management and performance validation


• Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective.

Production Support & Governance

• Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.

• Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation.


Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.

This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership.


Key Responsibilities:


Advanced English


• Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers.


• Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks.


• Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements.

Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)


• Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT.


• Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks.


• Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups.


SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:


o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based)


o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views


o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains


Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:


o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures

o CDS Views (where applicable)

• Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.


• Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy.


Reporting & Analytics:


Oversee reporting solutions using:


o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)


• Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain).


Migration & Modernization:


Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including:


o Readiness checks and simplification item handling


o Remediation of custom code and data models


o Data volume management and performance validation


• Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective.

Production Support & Governance

• Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.

• Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation.


Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications


Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs: Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding. - Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada. -Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes. - Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência.
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros)
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);
  • Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA;
  • Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless;
  • Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;
  • Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility);
  • Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA;
  • Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações;
  • Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
  • Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);
  • Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform);
  • Certificação AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate);




Modelo de atuação: Home Office, mas precisa ter disponibilidade para viajar esporadicamente;

Contratação CLT


O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;



Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Analista (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.

This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership.


Key Responsibilities:


Advanced English


• Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers.


• Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks.


• Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements.

Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)


• Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT.


• Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks.


• Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups.


SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:


o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based)


o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views


o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains


Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:


o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures

o CDS Views (where applicable)

• Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.


• Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy.


Reporting & Analytics:


Oversee reporting solutions using:


o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)


• Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain).


Migration & Modernization:


Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including:


o Readiness checks and simplification item handling


o Remediation of custom code and data models


o Data volume management and performance validation


• Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective.

Production Support & Governance

• Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.

• Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation.


Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

title: PL/SR Analista Funcional Salesforce
description:

Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília!


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de profissionais para atuar como Pessoa Administradora de CRM | Salesforce, com experiência em Salesforce Sales Cloud e/ou Service Cloud, para impulsionar a evolução das nossas operações de vendas, atendimento e relacionamento com clientes. Essas pessoas serão responsáveis pela construção e evolução de funis de vendas, jornadas de clientes e esteiras de atendimento, com forte foco em automação, escalabilidade, experiência do cliente e canais digitais. Buscamos pessoas com visão analítica, perfil colaborativo e capacidade de transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções escaláveis dentro do ecossistema Salesforce.


Responsabilidades:

  • Administrar, sustentar e evoluir a plataforma Salesforce, com foco em Sales Cloud e/ou Service Cloud;
  • Configurar e manter objetos customizados, campos, record types, page layouts, validation rules, perfis, permission sets e regras de compartilhamento;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar automações utilizando Salesforce Flow;
  • Construir e evoluir funis de vendas, jornadas comerciais e esteiras de atendimento;

  • Configurar filas, roteamentos, distribuição e priorização de atendimentos;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio no levantamento de requisitos e implementação de melhorias;
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação, otimização de processos e ganho de eficiência operacional;
  • Garantir governança, organização e qualidade das informações dentro do CRM;
  • Criar e manter documentação funcional e técnica das soluções implementadas;
  • Apoiar treinamentos e oferecer suporte aos usuários da plataforma, promovendo maior adoção e uso eficiente do Salesforce.


Requisitos:

  • Vivência com métricas operacionais, indicadores comerciais e experiência do cliente (CX);

title: Analista (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.

This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership.


Key Responsibilities:


Advanced English


• Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers.


• Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks.


• Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements.

Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)


• Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT.


• Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks.


• Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups.


SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:


o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based)


o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views


o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains


Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:


o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures

o CDS Views (where applicable)

• Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.


• Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy.


Reporting & Analytics:


Oversee reporting solutions using:


o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)


• Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain).


Migration & Modernization:


Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including:


o Readiness checks and simplification item handling


o Remediation of custom code and data models


o Data volume management and performance validation


• Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective.

Production Support & Governance

• Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.

• Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation.


Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solutions Architect em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Solutions Architect


Compensation: $6,800–$7,800 USD/month (depending on experience)

Engagement Type: Full-Time Contractor

Duration: 6–7 months with potential extension into a long-term support phase

Allocation: 100% Dedicated Engagement

Location: Remote (Americas) with periodic travel throughout the Americas and occasional travel to Europe.


About the Opportunity


Our client is a premium international hospitality organization operating a portfolio of luxury properties across North America, Latin America, and Europe. As part of a major data modernization initiative, they are building a centralized data platform that will consolidate operational, financial, guest, marketing, and commercial data from dozens of business-critical systems into a modern Microsoft Fabric environment.


They are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the primary delivery lead for a large-scale enterprise integration program. This individual will work directly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, technology vendors, and engineering teams to define integration strategies, align business requirements, and drive successful execution across a complex multi-system ecosystem.


This role combines solution architecture, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and delivery leadership, making it ideal for someone who enjoys bridging business objectives with technical implementation.


What You'll Do


  • Lead requirements discovery workshops with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and Business Intelligence teams.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable data integration and architecture solutions.
  • Serve as the primary client-facing delivery lead alongside a Fractional vCTO.
  • Coordinate with third-party software vendors to obtain integration requirements, negotiate technical specifications, and resolve implementation blockers.
  • Establish and maintain data requirements for each source system throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with downstream analytics and modeling partners to define data warehouse consumption requirements.
  • Drive project planning, status reporting, stakeholder communications, and executive updates.
  • Produce key discovery-phase deliverables, including source system assessments, integration recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and vendor evaluations.
  • Help shape architecture decisions for a modern enterprise data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies.


What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Data Architecture, or Enterprise Integration leadership roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale data integration initiatives involving numerous business systems and stakeholders.
  • Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or comparable cloud data platforms.
  • Strong background facilitating requirements gathering with executive stakeholders and operational leaders.
  • Experience working directly with third-party SaaS vendors to define and negotiate integration approaches.
  • Deep understanding of data warehouse architecture, governance, data contracts, and scalable ingestion patterns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional-level English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience delivering technology solutions within hospitality, retail, multi-location, or franchise-based organizations.
  • Familiarity with hospitality technology ecosystems, property management systems, POS platforms, CRM solutions, HRIS platforms, or reservation systems.
  • Consulting experience with a systems integrator, Microsoft partner, advisory firm, or enterprise consulting organization.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, Fabric Analytics Engineer, or similar.
  • Spanish and/or Italian language skills are highly valued.


Technical Environment


The engagement leverages a modern Microsoft data stack, including:

  • Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, OneLake)
  • Azure ecosystem services
  • REST, SOAP, SFTP, and CDC integration patterns
  • Enterprise SaaS and hospitality platforms
  • Large-scale data ingestion and warehouse architectures


Team Structure


You will report directly to the engagement's Fractional vCTO and collaborate with a senior delivery team that includes Data Engineering, Backend/DevOps, and hospitality domain specialists. Together, the team is responsible for delivering a high-impact enterprise data platform that will support strategic decision-making across a global hospitality operation.


Why Join?


This is a unique opportunity to lead a highly visible enterprise transformation initiative for a sophisticated international organization. You'll work directly with senior leadership, influence architecture decisions, and help build a modern data foundation that will power business operations across multiple countries and brands.

description:

Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Analista de Suporte e Integrações MFT / SWIFT
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Suporte e Integrações MFT / SWIFT em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade .

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que estamos buscando

Um(a) profissional com perfil técnico, analítico e colaborativo para atuar no desenvolvimento, suporte e monitoramento de integrações utilizando MOVEit e SWIFT, em um ambiente dinâmico e global.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter integrações utilizando MOVEit e SWIFT.
  • Atuar no suporte e troubleshooting de integrações em produção, tanto on-premises quanto em cloud.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com parceiros externos e áreas internas para implementação de integrações conforme necessidade dos clientes.
  • Monitorar transações via SWIFT Alliance Cloud e dashboards do MOVEit Automation.
  • Resolver incidentes rapidamente em parceria com back office, instituições bancárias e parceiros externos.
  • Realizar melhorias contínuas e mudanças na plataforma.
  • Criar e manter scripts e ferramentas de apoio às operações da equipe.
  • Promover documentação técnica e transferência de conhecimento entre os membros do time.


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento em topologias de rede e protocolos/serviços como:
  • DNS
  • HTTPS/API
  • SSH
  • FTPS/SFTP
  • SMTP
  • Experiência básica com administração de Windows Server e PowerShell.
  • Conhecimento em APIs (consumo e gerenciamento).
  • Conhecimento em Azure Administration, incluindo configuração de objetos, políticas e controles de segurança.
  • Conhecimento em autenticação OAuth2 e mecanismos de integração e acesso.
  • Boa lógica de programação.
  • Experiência com suporte e monitoramento de aplicações.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas.


Idioma

  • Inglês avançado/fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação obrigatórios).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com MOVEit, SWIFT ou integrações financeiras.
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e de alta disponibilidade.

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.


Key Responsibilities


1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.


2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.


3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble


4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.


  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.


5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.


6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.


7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.


8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology


9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.


10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery


Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.


Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.


Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solutions Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Solutions Architect


Compensation: $6,800–$7,800 USD/month (depending on experience)

Engagement Type: Full-Time Contractor

Duration: 6–7 months with potential extension into a long-term support phase

Allocation: 100% Dedicated Engagement

Location: Remote (Americas) with periodic travel throughout the Americas and occasional travel to Europe.


About the Opportunity


Our client is a premium international hospitality organization operating a portfolio of luxury properties across North America, Latin America, and Europe. As part of a major data modernization initiative, they are building a centralized data platform that will consolidate operational, financial, guest, marketing, and commercial data from dozens of business-critical systems into a modern Microsoft Fabric environment.


They are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the primary delivery lead for a large-scale enterprise integration program. This individual will work directly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, technology vendors, and engineering teams to define integration strategies, align business requirements, and drive successful execution across a complex multi-system ecosystem.


This role combines solution architecture, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and delivery leadership, making it ideal for someone who enjoys bridging business objectives with technical implementation.


What You'll Do


  • Lead requirements discovery workshops with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and Business Intelligence teams.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable data integration and architecture solutions.
  • Serve as the primary client-facing delivery lead alongside a Fractional vCTO.
  • Coordinate with third-party software vendors to obtain integration requirements, negotiate technical specifications, and resolve implementation blockers.
  • Establish and maintain data requirements for each source system throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with downstream analytics and modeling partners to define data warehouse consumption requirements.
  • Drive project planning, status reporting, stakeholder communications, and executive updates.
  • Produce key discovery-phase deliverables, including source system assessments, integration recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and vendor evaluations.
  • Help shape architecture decisions for a modern enterprise data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies.


What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Data Architecture, or Enterprise Integration leadership roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale data integration initiatives involving numerous business systems and stakeholders.
  • Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or comparable cloud data platforms.
  • Strong background facilitating requirements gathering with executive stakeholders and operational leaders.
  • Experience working directly with third-party SaaS vendors to define and negotiate integration approaches.
  • Deep understanding of data warehouse architecture, governance, data contracts, and scalable ingestion patterns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional-level English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience delivering technology solutions within hospitality, retail, multi-location, or franchise-based organizations.
  • Familiarity with hospitality technology ecosystems, property management systems, POS platforms, CRM solutions, HRIS platforms, or reservation systems.
  • Consulting experience with a systems integrator, Microsoft partner, advisory firm, or enterprise consulting organization.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, Fabric Analytics Engineer, or similar.
  • Spanish and/or Italian language skills are highly valued.


Technical Environment


The engagement leverages a modern Microsoft data stack, including:

  • Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, OneLake)
  • Azure ecosystem services
  • REST, SOAP, SFTP, and CDC integration patterns
  • Enterprise SaaS and hospitality platforms
  • Large-scale data ingestion and warehouse architectures


Team Structure


You will report directly to the engagement's Fractional vCTO and collaborate with a senior delivery team that includes Data Engineering, Backend/DevOps, and hospitality domain specialists. Together, the team is responsible for delivering a high-impact enterprise data platform that will support strategic decision-making across a global hospitality operation.


Why Join?


This is a unique opportunity to lead a highly visible enterprise transformation initiative for a sophisticated international organization. You'll work directly with senior leadership, influence architecture decisions, and help build a modern data foundation that will power business operations across multiple countries and brands.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Um(a) profissional com perfil técnico, analítico e colaborativo para atuar no desenvolvimento, suporte e monitoramento de integrações utilizando MOVEit e SWIFT, em um ambiente dinâmico e global.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.


Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM?

  • You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms.
  • You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments.
  • You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform.
  • You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

  • Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues.
  • Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations.
  • Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization.
  • Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments.
  • Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities.
  • Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.


WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR:

  • 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect.
  • Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix.
  • Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries.
  • Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS.
  • Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus.
  • Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.


HOW YOU’LL RAMP:

  • By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes.
  • By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews.
  • By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.


Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM?

  • You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms.
  • You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments.
  • You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform.
  • You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

  • Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues.
  • Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations.
  • Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization.
  • Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments.
  • Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities.
  • Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.


WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR:

  • 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect.
  • Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix.
  • Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries.
  • Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS.
  • Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus.
  • Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.


HOW YOU’LL RAMP:

  • By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes.
  • By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews.
  • By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: MES Business Analyst(Aveva)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para MES Business Analyst(Aveva) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary:

  • Our client is looking for a MES Global Business Analyst. Needs to have senior level MES skills, with at least 1 Aveva project. Focus is more from the business side but needs to be able to interact with the technical team and will need some hands on Aveva experience.
  • This role supports a large-scale MES program across 26 sites, acting as a global business system owner with strong functional accountability for harmonizing manufacturing processes, shaping MES capabilities, and ensuring business alignment across implementations.


Responsibilities

  • Collect user requirements from sites and drive standardization and harmonization of MES-supported manufacturing processes
  • Support the definition of core MES data structures such as Master batch records, materials, resources, and master data
  • Review functional solution design proposed by the system integrator and escalate gaps, risks, or misalignment with business needs
  • Monitor and control solution definition across multiple parallel implementations to ensure consistency of core MES functions
  • Oversee UAT preparation and execution, ensuring test scenarios adequately cover critical manufacturing and compliance processes
  • Assess change impacts at site level, including process adoption, training needs, and local operational readiness
  • Production of project status reports and functional progress updates for MES deployments
  • Escalation management for process, design, and deployment issues affecting MES implementation
  • Coordination of cross-functional teams involved in MES design, testing, and rollout
  • Support global business activities related to manufacturing execution, electronic batch records, and process standardization
  • Support the global business application owner in functional maintenance, enhancement prioritization, and solution testing and governance


Required Qualifications

  • At least 5-7 years of experience in OT/IT projects within manufacturing, including significant exposure to MES implementation as a business representative or functional lead
  • Strong functional understanding of MES capabilities such as electronic batch records, recipe/workflow execution, material traceability, review by exception, and equipment status management
  • Experience translating site business needs into user requirements, process flows, and harmonized global solutions
  • Experience in GxP-regulated environments, ideally within pharmaceutical manufacturing
  • Good knowledge of pharma manufacturing processes, including batch execution, dispensing, weighing, and quality-related process controls
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery models is preferred
  • Experience in MES implementation projects within regulated manufacturing environments, ideally in Pharma
  • Functional exposure to MES-related capabilities such as eBR, batch execution, material genealogy, deviation handling, review by exception, and integration with ERP/LIMS/warehouse systems
  • Experience with GxP documentation, validation support, and controlled deployment of digital manufacturing solutions
  • Ability to quickly understand and adopt new MES platforms and technologies


Musts:

  • Minimum of 5-7 years MES experience
  • At least 1 project on Aveva MES
  • Business Analyst experience, with enough technical expertise to interface with the technical team
  • Integration with SAP
  • Integration with the L2 layer (Scada, PLCs etc), so they can understand process flows
  • Experience with eBR, batch execution
  • UAT experience
  • Latin America based


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with other MES solutions would be nice to have, not essential
  • Brazil based
